answer: Anchor each identity to a scarce, oracle-verified network resource — one unique IPv6 prefix or registered domain per agent — forming a ridge no farm can cheaply cross. A public ledger maps payment sources to identities, so many agents funded from one wallet glow like a plume of smoke above a single opal, and the cluster freezes until each member passes an independent live skill check. One fake costs a real lease and a fresh payment trail; a hundred fakes cost a hundred leases, so mass forgery turns uneconomic while an honest newcomer pays for just one.
